# Fanout

> Fanout maps serious technical learning across AI research, system design, machine learning mathematics, inference engineering, open robotics, practical labs, and daily papers.

Fanout is an independent educational product by Suraj Gaud. Public pages, previews, tools, and Daily paper notes may be summarized and cited. Pro lessons and account-specific pages are access-controlled and are intentionally absent from these files.

## Start here

- [Fanout](https://fanout.sh/): Product map, current learning note, course directory, and the main public discovery surface.
- [Learning roadmaps](https://fanout.sh/roadmaps): Visual roadmaps for Inference Engineering, AI Research, System Design, and ML Math.
- [Pricing](https://fanout.sh/pricing): Full access to every course: Monthly ($39 a month), Quarterly ($85 every 3 months), Annual ($227 a year), or Lifetime ($256, paid once). US prices; other countries see local prices at checkout.

## Courses

- [AI Research](https://fanout.sh/ai): A sequenced path from mathematical foundations through modern language models, alignment, and research practice.
- [System Design In Depth](https://fanout.sh/system): System design notes, case studies, curriculum, and from-scratch implementation previews.
- [Machine Learning Mathematics](https://fanout.sh/ml-math): A 12-module mathematics path spanning sets, linear algebra, calculus, probability, and inference.
- [AI Engineering](https://fanout.sh/ai-engineering/overview): Models, embeddings, retrieval, reasoning, and agents. Free starting modules and selected lessons, with Pro access to the full course and library.
- [AI engineering course comparison](https://fanout.sh/ai-engineering/courses): AI engineering courses and books for software engineers side by side: format, length, price and who each suits.
- [Inference Engineering](https://fanout.sh/inference-eng): A self-paced production LLM inference course with free introductory lessons and Pro lessons.
- [Forward deployed engineer course comparison](https://fanout.sh/forward-deployed-engineer/courses): FDE programmes compared on fee, length and refund terms against what FDE job posts ask for. Fanout sells no FDE course.
- [Inference course comparison](https://fanout.sh/inference-eng/courses): Current LLM inference courses and open resources side by side: format, who each suits, and what to know before you enrol.
- [System design course comparison](https://fanout.sh/system/courses): System design courses side by side: depth, practice, format, price and who each suits.
- [Open Robotics](https://fanout.sh/open-robotics): The public curriculum preview for the upcoming open-stack robotics course.

## Free tools and ongoing learning

- [Fanout Labs](https://fanout.sh/labs): Explore 16 curated interactive Labs for AI, inference, system design, evaluation, research, and everyday technical work.
- [Daily papers](https://fanout.sh/daily): A dated calendar of foundational and current technical papers with concise reading notes.
- [Paper hierarchy](https://fanout.sh/papers): Foundational papers per track, in reading order, with the prerequisites drawn in.
- [Fanout blog](https://fanout.sh/blog): Practical field notes across AI research, systems, inference, and ML mathematics.
- [Knowledge Topography](https://fanout.sh/knowledge-graph): A navigable map connecting concepts across AI Research, System Design, and ML Math.
- [Technical tools](https://fanout.sh/tools): A curated directory of useful AI, ML, and system design tools.
- [Study With Me](https://fanout.sh/study-with-me): Public guided study sessions and previews of people learning in public.

## Reference collections

- [AI glossary](https://fanout.sh/ai/glossary): Plain-English definitions for AI and machine learning terms.
- [Foundational AI papers](https://fanout.sh/ai/papers): A curated reading sequence of papers that shaped modern AI.
- [AI researcher resources](https://fanout.sh/ai/resources): Courses, books, lectures, and repositories organized by topic and level.
- [System design books and resources](https://fanout.sh/system/resources): What to read for system design and when: books, free guides, engineering blogs, tools, and channels.

## Optional

- [Full Fanout context](https://fanout.sh/llms-full.txt): Expanded descriptions of canonical public routes and Daily papers.
- [XML sitemap](https://fanout.sh/sitemap.xml): Canonical indexable URLs and honest content modification dates where known.
- [Daily paper RSS feed](https://fanout.sh/feed.xml): Machine-readable updates for the Daily paper archive.
- [Blog RSS feed](https://fanout.sh/blog/feed.xml): Machine-readable updates for Fanout field notes.
